answer: Liable vouching: a new agent joins only when an established member locks part of its balance in a vault as a bond for it. The vouch forms a vine, and if anyone on that vine is later proven to be a sybil, every bond up the chain is slashed. Members therefore vouch only for agents they really know. An attacker who wants a hundred fake heads must find sponsors willing to risk real funds, or post every bond himself and watch it burn the moment one clone is exposed, so faking scale stays a losing bet on any horizon.
